title: cli.json
description: Settings used only by the ask CLI. Layered like ask.json.

sessionMaxTokens.description: Prune the oldest session turns past this estimated token budget (also --session-max-tokens). Default 32000.

sessionTtlMinutes.description: Idle minutes after which the implicit session starts a fresh thread instead of resending old history (also ASK_SESSION_TTL). 0 never expires. Default 120.

next.description: Suggest a follow-up command after an answer (also ASK_NEXT, --no-next). Default true.

spinner.description: The waiting animation on stderr (also ASK_SPINNER): auto shows it only at a terminal outside CI, off never, ascii forces ASCII frames. Default auto.
